Since there's no real portal channel option, I'll reply via email on file, referencing the existing thread and mentioning the portal chat for continuity, while being careful not to overpromise on repair timing given the tenant's vulnerable situation.

I shouldn't quote exact figures to the tenant, and the bin issue falls outside our remit—that's a council matter for Tower Hamlets. For the 14 Oct visit, I should treat it as a recorded entry in the system history rather than something I'm confirming independently, phrasing it as "the record shows a visit pencilled in for 14 Oct."

arguments.body: Hi Jonah, sorry for the wait. Boiler job R-4799: the engineer visited and recommended replacing a part (the expansion vessel). The landlord has asked for a second quote before agreeing, and our records show a second engineer (Swift P&H) due to visit on 14 October. Once we have that quote we'll go back to the landlord for a decision. Until then please keep topping up the pressure as you have been. If you lose heating or hot water completely, or see leaks or smell gas, tell us straight away (gas emergency line 0800 111 999). We'll update you again after the 14th. On bins: we don't handle collections. Please report the missed collection to Tower Hamlets Council on their website, as they can confirm the collection day. Thanks, Property Management team.
